name: Credential and API-Key Vault
description: Store provider credentials (API keys, tokens, secrets) securely. All credential access must go through the secret broker, never logged or exposed. Implements encryption at rest, access auditing, rotation support, and secure injection into provider clients without exposing raw secrets to application code.
purpose: Centralize credential management for all LLM providers with security guarantees — encryption, audit, rotation — while ensuring credentials are never accidentally logged or exposed.
acceptanceCriteria: Secrets are encrypted at rest using AEAD encryption
Secret broker provides a get/rotate/revoke API
No credential value appears in logs, error messages, or stack traces
Access audit log records every credential fetch with caller identity and timestamp
Credentials can be injected into HTTP headers and request builders without exposing raw values in application scope
Rotation endpoint that creates new version and deprecates old one with grace period
Environment variable fallback with clear warnings when used
Integration test proving credential is never present in log output
